title: Harbor — a reply, end to end
thesis: A support queue is one place, and Harbor keeps the state of every conversation in it.
audience: Support leads evaluating a helpdesk; watching muted on a phone.
sound: silent, with cuts on the click and the send
note: The app on screen is Harbor, a fictional support desk. Every state is reached by a real click on the real element; the loading state and the toast are the app's own.

beats.title: Open · the queue
beats.camera: Static on the conversation column; app sits below a reserved caption band.
beats.motion: Nothing moves but the cursor. The first caption fades in over 180ms.
beats.action: Hold the column long enough to read three subjects.

captions.text: Every customer question, in one queue.

keyframes.note: Caption in the band; the list reads at phone size.

beats.title: Open one conversation
beats.camera: Small push to the row, then a vertical slice through the thread: header, message, reply.
beats.motion: Cursor travels on an arc to the row and clicks it; the thread shows Harbor's own loading state for 420ms, then the thread slides up.
beats.action: Click the first conversation. The thread loads and the history appears.

captions.text: Open one and the whole history is there.

keyframes.note: Mid-push as the row is clicked.
The thread, scrolled to the latest message.

beats.title: Write and send a reply
beats.camera: Close on the composer, then pull back far enough to reach Send.
beats.motion: Text types at 42ms a character, seeded so the pacing is identical on every render. The Send button takes the hand before it is pressed.
beats.action: Click the composer, type the reply, click Send.
beats.honesty: The typed line is a real reply, not a macro or a canned result.

keyframes.note: The reply being typed; composer focused.

beats.title: The state changes by itself
beats.camera: The new message and the toast, held still; the state change is the subject.
beats.motion: The reply lands, a toast confirms it, and the chip flips Open to Pending.
beats.action: Nothing is clicked. The app does the work.

captions.text: Harbor tracks the state for you.

beats.title: Out · the queue again
beats.camera: Pull back to the opening framing.
beats.motion: One 1.2s move on the house curve; the caption follows.
beats.action: Return to the list, where the row now shows the reply.

keyframes.note: Same framing as the open, so the loop reads.

beats.title: End card
beats.motion: Card fades in over 250ms and holds still. Last frame doubles as the thumbnail.
beats.action: Harbor wordmark, one line of context, the install command.

openQuestions.note: 23.7s suits a social feed and a README.
openQuestions.pick: Keep it under 25s; the wide cut reuses the same script.

openQuestions.note: The typed line is invented for the film.
openQuestions.pick: Keep it; if you want different words, they are one string in film.mjs.
